No account is required to start. While you can use the core features immediately, signing up for a free account offers benefits like saving your history and managing multiple document chats.

### Can I interact with several documents at once?

Yes! Simply organize your files and PDFs into a folder, and our tool can analyze them collectively. This allows you to ask PDF AI questions that draw on information from multiple documents simultaneously.

### Is my data secure?

Your privacy and security are important to us. You have full control over your data, including the option to delete files and chats at any time.

### Can I use the tool in multiple languages? [...] ### Can I use the tool in multiple languages?

Yes, the platform is fully multilingual. Upload documents in any language and even pose questions in a different language, making it ideal for international research and diverse projects. Languages we support include English, Spanish, Chinese, Hindi, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and many more.

### Will it work on any device?

Certainly. Our tool is optimized for desktops, tablets, and smartphones—any device with a web browser will let you access and analyze your documents on the go. PDF AI is fully compatible with all devices that ChatPDF is compatible with. Best results are on our free desktop app.
